name: Bubblydoll/Wildmachine
original_name: ばぶりーどーる/わいるどましーん
source:
This work is an afterstory for the normal ending of the main game “Lovelydoll/Wildmachine”.
One day, the protagonist suddenly loses their human body to a doll,
and this is a heartwarming daily-life adventure about being reborn anew.
translation:
This work is an afterstory for the normal ending of the main game “Lovelydoll/Wildmachine”.
One day, the protagonist suddenly loses their human body to a doll,
and this is a heartwarming daily-life adventure about being reborn anew.
